scope: UK grocery category CPI monthly change, not individual SKU unit price or shrink events
selection_basis: Lowest pretest validation MAE on common dates; test outcomes never select the winner

source_metadata.scope: UK category CPI percentage changes; not SKU prices or shrinkflation probabilities
source_metadata.commodity_input_frequency: genuine weekly observations, including daily-to-weekly source aggregates
source_metadata.target_formula: 100 * (category CPI index in target month / previous calendar month index - 1)
source_metadata.historical_forecast_cutoff: 00:00 Europe/London on eighth day of previous calendar month
source_metadata.live_forecast_cutoff: as_of date, 00:00 Europe/London; target is next calendar month
source_metadata.cpi_feature_policy: Only index observations through issue month minus two calendar months; calendar gaps are not filled
source_metadata.label_availability_policy: First day of target month plus two months, conservatively after usual following-month ONS publication
source_metadata.weekly_availability_policy: Completed weekly period plus seven days for ICCO/ECB, fourteen for EU; stale beyond35days becomes missing

chocolate.license: Open Government Licence v3.0; attribute ONS

crisps.license: Open Government Licence v3.0; attribute ONS

roll_conventions: Average nearest three active ICE London/New York futures months; shift on 15th of month preceding nearest maturing month; London conversion uses six-month forward FX. See ICCO methodology.

gbp_per_usd.formula: weekly mean GBP/EUR divided by weekly mean USD/EUR; ratio of means, not mean of daily crosses

limitations: Archive revisions are not reconstructed; buffers are explicit assumptions, not verified historical release timestamps.
Category indices do not establish individual brand, retailer, pack-size or recipe changes.
Cocoa, grain and exchange-rate references are proxies, not manufacturer purchase contracts or a complete ingredient cost model.
No monthly commodity interpolation; no monthly World Bank values used as weekly inputs.
Historical targets are observed values; missing labels and inapplicable or missing commodity features remain NaN.

categories.selection_basis: Lowest pretest validation MAE on common dates; test outcomes never select the winner
Lowest pretest validation MAE on common dates; test outcomes never select the winner

limitations: Category indices cannot identify a manufacturer's shrink/price/recipe mechanism.
Historical archives may contain corrections; source availability assumptions are documented, not recovered original vintages.
No calibrated SKU probabilities or causal ingredient cost pass-through claims.
No prediction intervals emitted: independent post-selection calibration is not established.
